595 reviews. 4 stars. And most tourists drive straight past Suoi Tranh Waterfall on the way to the beach.

This is one of Phu Quoc's few inland natural spots worth the detour. Jungle trail, actual rushing water, and zero beach crowds. Hit it early and you'll have it nearly to yourself.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
